changelog: Notes+ is on the web now: open notes.talken.in/app in any browser, sign in, and your notes are there, locked ones included (same lock). Install over this version; don't uninstall first.

desktop.changelog: Notes+ for Windows 12: export any note as one .npnote file (colours and pictures included) for a USB stick, linked files go to the Recycle Bin with their note, and Notes+ on the web.
